name: Letkés (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow-green, white and yellow-green in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Letkés (a red shield with a bunch of grapes and a boat) below the name LETKÉS in yellow.
history: The arms and flag of Letkés were adopted in 1998. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
